messages.subject: International Executive | ESG, Government Relations & External Affairs Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Selah Strategic Team,

Your leadership advisory and executive-search work across strategic and complex organisations aligns with my background in mining, institutional engagement and responsible business. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where leadership effectiveness depends on trusted external relationships and disciplined execution. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, with broader international mobility.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
